# Case 33: Future work as a list of unrelated directions
Skill: write-abstracts-and-conclusions
Expected gates: G-AC-future
Language: en
Snippet:
> In future work, we will consider multi-station cooperation. We will also build a real-world testbed. In addition, security and privacy will be studied, and large language models will be explored.
Why it fails: none of the directions answers a limitation stated in the paper, and they do not build on each other. Future work should extend the model to remove a stated limitation, build the method on that model, and then address the resulting computational cost.
